title: Project Manager
jobDescription:
Do you want to be part of a team who shapes the future of power managements with products and solutions using Ga N devices that make systems more efficient and smarter?

Job Description
In your new role you will:
  • Be responsible for Project Management for integrated Ga N products / System Projects.
  • Manage the activities to develop the required silicon drivers or controllers dies and the Ga N HEMTs and combine these in one package.
  • Coordinate and lead projects from requirements gathering through chip design, characterization, and qualification, all the way to volume ramp-up.
  • Lead cross-functional and multicultural project teams from various locations, creating the energy and passion to reach ambitious project targets
  • Take full project management responsibility for all project targets and plans (milestones, resources, risks, budget, costs)
  • Facilitate timely project decision-making, ensure consistent progress, and lead through challenges while serving as a role model for the team.
  • Handle the project in a fast and market-driven environment with a clear focus on the business objectives, support customer interactions as needed
  • Own the project results, deliverables and success.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process to be leaner and thus faster.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Passion to shape Ga N development and -projects to drive them to success in a highly competitive environment.
  • 5 years of experience in leading end to end semiconductor development projects with relevant functional experience.
  • Must have driven projects from product definition to qualification and volume production
  • Should have reasonable understanding of business case development processes and semiconductor product development budget.
  • Should have worked with or lead project teams that include functional leads for product definition, design, design verification, test and characterization, application and marketing, quality and reliability and manufacturing including wafer fabrication and packaging.
  • Demonstrated Project Management skills (IPMA-C certification is a plus).
  • Experience of leading cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
  • Willingness to travel internationally from time to time, mainly to our locations in Europe and Asia.
  • A degree in Electrical Engineering, System Engineering, Power Electronics, or comparable.
  • Excellent English language and presentation skills.




Contact:
Vidhi Ashok.Thakkar@infineon.com

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

Job Description
In your new role you will:
  • Be responsible for Project Management for integrated Ga N products / System Projects.
  • Manage the activities to develop the required silicon drivers or controllers dies and the Ga N HEMTs and combine these in one package.
  • Coordinate and lead projects from requirements gathering through chip design, characterization, and qualification, all the way to volume ramp-up.
  • Lead cross-functional and multicultural project teams from various locations, creating the energy and passion to reach ambitious project targets
  • Take full project management responsibility for all project targets and plans (milestones, resources, risks, budget, costs)
  • Facilitate timely project decision-making, ensure consistent progress, and lead through challenges while serving as a role model for the team.
  • Handle the project in a fast and market-driven environment with a clear focus on the business objectives, support customer interactions as needed
  • Own the project results, deliverables and success.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process to be leaner and thus faster.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Passion to shape Ga N development and -projects to drive them to success in a highly competitive environment.
  • 5 years of experience in leading end to end semiconductor development projects with relevant functional experience.
  • Must have driven projects from product definition to qualification and volume production
  • Should have reasonable understanding of business case development processes and semiconductor product development budget.
  • Should have worked with or lead project teams that include functional leads for product definition, design, design verification, test and characterization, application and marketing, quality and reliability and manufacturing including wafer fabrication and packaging.
  • Demonstrated Project Management skills (IPMA-C certification is a plus).
  • Experience of leading cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
  • Willingness to travel internationally from time to time, mainly to our locations in Europe and Asia.
  • A degree in Electrical Engineering, System Engineering, Power Electronics, or comparable.
  • Excellent English language and presentation skills.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

description:
Do you want to be part of a team who shapes the future of power managements with products and solutions using Ga N devices that make systems more efficient and smarter?

Job Description
In your new role you will:
  • Be responsible for Project Management for integrated Ga N products / System Projects.
  • Manage the activities to develop the required silicon drivers or controllers dies and the Ga N HEMTs and combine these in one package.
  • Coordinate and lead projects from requirements gathering through chip design, characterization, and qualification, all the way to volume ramp-up.
  • Lead cross-functional and multicultural project teams from various locations, creating the energy and passion to reach ambitious project targets
  • Take full project management responsibility for all project targets and plans (milestones, resources, risks, budget, costs)
  • Facilitate timely project decision-making, ensure consistent progress, and lead through challenges while serving as a role model for the team.
  • Handle the project in a fast and market-driven environment with a clear focus on the business objectives, support customer interactions as needed
  • Own the project results, deliverables and success.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process to be leaner and thus faster.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Passion to shape Ga N development and -projects to drive them to success in a highly competitive environment.
  • 5 years of experience in leading end to end semiconductor development projects with relevant functional experience.
  • Must have driven projects from product definition to qualification and volume production
  • Should have reasonable understanding of business case development processes and semiconductor product development budget.
  • Should have worked with or lead project teams that include functional leads for product definition, design, design verification, test and characterization, application and marketing, quality and reliability and manufacturing including wafer fabrication and packaging.
  • Demonstrated Project Management skills (IPMA-C certification is a plus).
  • Experience of leading cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
  • Willingness to travel internationally from time to time, mainly to our locations in Europe and Asia.
  • A degree in Electrical Engineering, System Engineering, Power Electronics, or comparable.
  • Excellent English language and presentation skills.




Contact:
Vidhi Ashok.Thakkar@infineon.com

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

efficient and smarter?

Job Description
In your new role you will:
  • Be responsible for Project Management for integrated Ga N products / System Projects.
  • Manage the activities to develop the required silicon drivers or controllers dies and the Ga N HEMTs and combine these in one package.
  • Coordinate and lead projects from requirements gathering through chip design, characterization, and qualification, all the way to volume ramp-up.
  • Lead cross-functional and multicultural project teams from various locations, creating the energy and passion to reach ambitious project targets
  • Take full project management responsibility for all project targets and plans (milestones, resources, risks, budget, costs)
  • Facilitate timely project decision-making, ensure consistent progress, and lead through challenges while serving as a role model for the team.
  • Handle the project in a fast and market-driven environment with a clear focus on the business objectives, support customer interactions as needed
  • Own the project results, deliverables and success.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process to be leaner and thus faster.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Passion to shape Ga N development and -projects to drive them to success in a highly competitive environment.
  • 5 years of experience in leading end to end semiconductor development projects with relevant functional experience.
  • Must have driven projects from product definition to qualification and volume production
  • Should have reasonable understanding of business case development processes and semiconductor product development budget.
  • Should have worked with or lead project teams that include functional leads for product definition, design, design verification, test and characterization, application and marketing, quality and reliability and manufacturing including wafer fabrication and packaging.
  • Demonstrated Project Management skills (IPMA-C certification is a plus).
  • Experience of leading cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
  • Willingness to travel internationally from time to time, mainly to our locations in Europe and Asia.
  • A degree in Electrical Engineering, System Engineering, Power Electronics, or comparable.
  • Excellent English language and presentation skills.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

title: Senior Staff Specialist IT - Windchill
jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced Java Windchill Developer specializing in Windchill to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible to design, develop, and maintain customizations, integrations utilizing Windchill. The Java developer will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and QA, to deliver high-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

Job Description
In your new role you will:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Windchill applications, integrations, and plugins using Java, to meet business requirements and improve product lifecycle management.
  • Develop custom APIs using Windchill's Java-based API, to integrate with other systems, services, or applications, ensuring seamless data exchange and functionality.
  • Implement business logic, workflows, and rules using Windchill's Java-based scripting engine, to automate and streamline product development, manufacturing, and quality processes.
  • Ensure high-quality code, following best practices, coding standards, and Windchill's development guidelines, to maintain scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including business stakeholders, project managers, and other developers, to ensure successful project delivery and effective communication.
  • Stay current with Windchill's latest releases, features, and best practices, applying this knowledge to improve custom applications, integrations, and plugins.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • At least 6+ years of experience in Java development for Windchill.
  • Proficiency in Java, including Java 8 or later, with experience in Java-based development, debugging, and troubleshooting.
  • In-depth knowledge of Windchill's architecture, APIs, and development tools
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Familiarity with Dev Ops practices and tools, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Windchill Certifications is added advantage.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies, including Scrum or Kanban.

Anand Narendrakumar.Rawal@infineon.com

title: Application Support Consultant
jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced Application Support Consultant specializing in Windchill to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible to perform Configurations at UI level, Bulk Data Corrections, Data Validation in Windchill Production system. Will be responsible for smooth operations of PLM functionalities and features supporting the end users and Customers. The Application Support Consultant will work closely with cross-functional teams, Service Owners/application owners, Business Owners, to maintain robust PLM functionalities and workflow serving the end users.

Job Description

In your new role you will:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Utilities to enable Windchill applications, workflows, and integrations to meet business requirements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and develop solutions that meet business needs.
  • Develop and maintain SQL scripts.
  • Develop reports using QML.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve Windchill-related issues, including performance with data integrity, and security in mind.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for all Application Support activities.
  • Work on Incident Management, Service Request Fulfilment as in a L2 role.
  • Collaborate with L3 functional and L3 technical teams to resolve problems.
  • Work with external Business partners and guide the team whenever necessary.
  • Resolve Major tickets within the defined SLA.
  • Get the Handover from Project.
  • Documentation of SOP procedures and ensure Operational Excellence.
  • Work with deployment team to deploy the developed scripts during the Project release.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 3+ years of experience in Windchill development or Windchill Maintenance or Windchill Migration with a strong understanding of Windchill Architecture, Windchill Business Administration and knowledge in Windchill Database structures.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries and Oracle procedures.
  • Strong understanding of PLM concepts, data modelling, and data governance.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams.
  • Willing to work in shift. Especially support European time zone.
  • Process oriented mindset. Able to Optimise and Automate using latest technologies.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (scrum or kanban) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Added advantage if you are ITIL certified

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

You may voluntarily self-identify as having a disability on this form without fear of any punishment because you did not identify as having a disability earlier.

How do I know if I have a disability?
You are considered to have a disability if you have a physical or mental impairment or medical condition that substantially limits a major life activity, or if you have a history or record of such an impairment or medical condition.

• Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
• Deafness

• Major depression
• Obsessive compulsive disorder
• Cancer
• HIV/AIDS
• Multiple sclerosis (MS)

Data": {"display Banner": false, "display Text": ""}} We are looking for an experienced Application Support Consultant specializing in Windchill to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible to perform Configurations at UI level, Bulk Data Corrections, Data Validation in Windchill Production system. Will be responsible for smooth operations of PLM functionalities and features supporting the end users and Customers. The Application Support Consultant will work closely with cross-functional teams, Service Owners/application owners, Business Owners, to maintain robust PLM functionalities and workflow serving the end users.

Job Description

In your new role you will:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Utilities to enable Windchill applications, workflows, and integrations to meet business requirements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and develop solutions that meet business needs.
  • Develop and maintain SQL scripts.
  • Develop reports using QML.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve Windchill-related issues, including performance with data integrity, and security in mind.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for all Application Support activities.
  • Work on Incident Management, Service Request Fulfilment as in a L2 role.
  • Collaborate with L3 functional and L3 technical teams to resolve problems.
  • Work with external Business partners and guide the team whenever necessary.
  • Resolve Major tickets within the defined SLA.
  • Get the Handover from Project.
  • Documentation of SOP procedures and ensure Operational Excellence.
  • Work with deployment team to deploy the developed scripts during the Project release.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 3+ years of experience in Windchill development or Windchill Maintenance or Windchill Migration with a strong understanding of Windchill Architecture, Windchill Business Administration and knowledge in Windchill Database structures.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries and Oracle procedures.
  • Strong understanding of PLM concepts, data modelling, and data governance.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams.
  • Willing to work in shift. Especially support European time zone.
  • Process oriented mindset. Able to Optimise and Automate using latest technologies.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (scrum or kanban) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Added advantage if you are ITIL certified

1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

description:
We are looking for an experienced Application Support Consultant specializing in Windchill to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible to perform Configurations at UI level, Bulk Data Corrections, Data Validation in Windchill Production system. Will be responsible for smooth operations of PLM functionalities and features supporting the end users and Customers. The Application Support Consultant will work closely with cross-functional teams, Service Owners/application owners, Business Owners, to maintain robust PLM functionalities and workflow serving the end users.

Job Description

In your new role you will:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Utilities to enable Windchill applications, workflows, and integrations to meet business requirements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and develop solutions that meet business needs.
  • Develop and maintain SQL scripts.
  • Develop reports using QML.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve Windchill-related issues, including performance with data integrity, and security in mind.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for all Application Support activities.
  • Work on Incident Management, Service Request Fulfilment as in a L2 role.
  • Collaborate with L3 functional and L3 technical teams to resolve problems.
  • Work with external Business partners and guide the team whenever necessary.
  • Resolve Major tickets within the defined SLA.
  • Get the Handover from Project.
  • Documentation of SOP procedures and ensure Operational Excellence.
  • Work with deployment team to deploy the developed scripts during the Project release.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 3+ years of experience in Windchill development or Windchill Maintenance or Windchill Migration with a strong understanding of Windchill Architecture, Windchill Business Administration and knowledge in Windchill Database structures.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries and Oracle procedures.
  • Strong understanding of PLM concepts, data modelling, and data governance.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams.
  • Willing to work in shift. Especially support European time zone.
  • Process oriented mindset. Able to Optimise and Automate using latest technologies.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (scrum or kanban) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Added advantage if you are ITIL certified



Contact:
Anand Narendrakumar.Rawal@infineon.com

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

Data": {"display Banner": false, "display Text": ""}} We are looking for an experienced Application Support Consultant specializing in Windchill to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible to perform Configurations at UI level, Bulk Data Corrections, Data Validation in Windchill Production system. Will be responsible for smooth operations of PLM functionalities and features supporting the end users and Customers. The Application Support Consultant will work closely with cross-functional teams, Service Owners/application owners, Business Owners, to maintain robust PLM functionalities and workflow serving the end users.

Job Description

In your new role you will:
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Utilities to enable Windchill applications, workflows, and integrations to meet business requirements.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and develop solutions that meet business needs.
  • Develop and maintain SQL scripts.
  • Develop reports using QML.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve Windchill-related issues, including performance with data integrity, and security in mind.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for all Application Support activities.
  • Work on Incident Management, Service Request Fulfilment as in a L2 role.
  • Collaborate with L3 functional and L3 technical teams to resolve problems.
  • Work with external Business partners and guide the team whenever necessary.
  • Resolve Major tickets within the defined SLA.
  • Get the Handover from Project.
  • Documentation of SOP procedures and ensure Operational Excellence.
  • Work with deployment team to deploy the developed scripts during the Project release.


Your Profile
You are best equipped for this task if you have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 3+ years of experience in Windchill development or Windchill Maintenance or Windchill Migration with a strong understanding of Windchill Architecture, Windchill Business Administration and knowledge in Windchill Database structures.
  • Proficiency in writing SQL queries and Oracle procedures.
  • Strong understanding of PLM concepts, data modelling, and data governance.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams.
  • Willing to work in shift. Especially support European time zone.
  • Process oriented mindset. Able to Optimise and Automate using latest technologies.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (scrum or kanban) and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Added advantage if you are ITIL certified

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:

Job description Benefits and company information Job Id HRC1154845 Job Family Research & Development Duration of Employment Permanent Join as Graduate We are looking for an experienced Application Support Consultant specializing in Windchill to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible to perform Configurations at UI level, Bulk Data Corrections, Data Validation in Windchill Production system. Will be responsible for smooth operations of PLM functionalities and features supporting the end users and Customers. The Application Support Consultant will work closely with cross-functional teams, Service Owners/application owners, Business Owners, to maintain robust PLM functionalities and workflow serving the end users. Job Description In your new role you will: Design, develop, test, and deploy custom Utilities to enable Windchill applications, workflows, and integrations to meet business requirements. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define scope, and develop solutions that meet business needs. Develop and maintain SQL scripts. Develop reports using QML. Troubleshoot and resolve Windchill-related issues, including performance with data integrity, and security in mind. Develop and maintain technical documentation for all Application Support activities. Work on Incident Management, Service Request Fulfilment as in a L2 role. Collaborate with L3 functional and L3 technical teams to resolve problems. Work with external Business partners and guide the team whenever necessary. Resolve Major tickets within the defined SLA. Get the Handover from Project. Documentation of SOP procedures and ensure Operational Excellence. Work with deployment team to deploy the developed scripts during the Project release. Your Profile You are best equipped for this task if you have: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. At least 3+ years of experience in Windchill development or Windchill Maintenance or Windchill Migration with a strong understanding of Windchill Architecture, Windchill Business Administration and knowledge in Windchill Database structures. Proficiency in writing SQL queries and Oracle procedures. Strong understanding of PLM concepts, data modelling , and data governance . Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to debug and troubleshoot complex issues. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams. This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

title: Senior Staff Engineer Verification
jobDescription:
In depth understanding of ASIC verification concepts and techniques . Ability to architect complex module / sub system / full chip testbenches and build verification infrastructure in SV/UVM.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new ROLE:
  • Verification of complex So Cs / IPs and provide technical leadership to the team while creating test plans and Verification Infrastructure
  • Adopt state of art Verification methods. Develop expertise in multiple areas of verification – Formal/Gate level/Power aware Verification
  • Drive Verification closure of complex IPs and So Cs using SV/UVM based methodology
  • Developing C models for DSP and Verification
  • Schedule management and handling cross functional team interactions
  • Mentoring and guiding the team to keep Verification execution on track.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed:
    • EDUCATION: B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech
    • Experience: Bachelor's - 9 to 11 years or Master’s - 8 to 10 years
    • In depth understanding of ASIC verification concepts and techniques. Ability to architect complex module / sub system / full chip testbenches and build verification infrastructure in SV/UVM.
    • Should be a good mentor and guide the junior engineers in the team. Experience in ARM based So C verification covering RTL, Power Aware and Gate level simulations is a plus.
    • Knowledge on Ethernet (IEEE 802.3), MIPI protocols, Display Port is highly preferable. Should have the experience in building C models for DSP and Verification

title: Specialist SCM
jobDescription:
We are seeking highly motivated and analytical individuals to join our Supply Chain Planning team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work in a fast-paced, global environment where you will help drive supply chain excellence through data-driven decision-making, cross-functional collaboration, and process optimization. As a Supply Chain Planning Analyst, you will play a critical role in aligning customer requirements with operational capabilities, ensuring efficient planning and execution across the supply chain

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Understand customer product requirements and ensure supply chain plans are aligned to meet business and customer expectations.
  • Analyze supply chain data, business trends, and operational challenges to identify root causes and recommend effective solutions.
  • Support demand, supply, inventory, and production planning activities through data-driven insights.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Operations, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Sales to drive business objectives.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and contribute to overall business performance.
  • Implement and support supply chain processes, tools, and systems that enable scalable growth and operational excellence.
  • Work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced, and global environment with shared responsibilities across multiple geographies.
  • Generate reports, dashboards, and performance metrics to support planning and decision-making processes.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Required

    • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Supply Chain Management, or a related Science discipline.
    • 0–1 year of experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, Analytics, or related domains.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and macros.
    • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Ability to work effectively across organizational boundaries, functions, and cultures.
    • Comfortable working in ambiguous situations and adapting to changing business priorities.

    Preferred

    • Exposure to enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems such as SAP or Oracle.
    • Familiarity with supply chain planning platforms such as JDA, Blue Yonder, or i2 Technologies.
    • Basic knowledge of PL/SQL or database querying concepts.
    • Academic or project exposure to Statistics, Operations Research, forecasting, optimization, or supply chain analytics.
    • Internship experience in Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Logistics, Planning, or Operations.

title: Staff Specialist Machine Learning Engineering
jobDescription:
We are hiring for Software Engineer with strong hands on exposure in ML (Python, Java Script, or similar). Must have experience building end-to-end solutions (APIs, services, internal applications). Ability to work effectively with incomplete requirements and multiple stakeholders. Apply AI/ML-enabled tools where they add clear value.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

• Collaborate with software engineers and business analysts to clarify ambiguous problems, define requirements, and design practical solutions.
• Build and maintain internal platforms, APIs, and automation frameworks that enable multiple teams.
• Optimize existing workflows or create new, more efficient ones using bespoke tools, inter-departmental solutions, or existing company software.
• Apply AI/ML-enabled tools where they add clear value.
• Ensure solutions adhere to IT best practices without sacrificing timely delivery.
• Document assumptions, decisions, and limitations clearly.
• Monitor adoption and iterate based on feedback and real-world usage.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• Strong software engineering foundation (Python, Java Script, or similar).
• Experience building end-to-end solutions (APIs, services, internal applications).• Good understanding of IT fundamentals and deployment practices(Open Shift experience is a plus).
• Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g. Denodo) and web application development.
• Ability to work effectively with incomplete requirements and multiple stakeholders.
• Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools (e.g., forecasting, optimization) without being a research-focused role.
• Experience integrating third-party APIs and automation tools.
• Familiarity with supply chain or operational workflows is a plus.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

• Collaborate with software engineers and business analysts to clarify ambiguous problems, define requirements, and design practical solutions.
• Build and maintain internal platforms, APIs, and automation frameworks that enable multiple teams.
• Optimize existing workflows or create new, more efficient ones using bespoke tools, inter-departmental solutions, or existing company software.
• Apply AI/ML-enabled tools where they add clear value.
• Ensure solutions adhere to IT best practices without sacrificing timely delivery.
• Document assumptions, decisions, and limitations clearly.
• Monitor adoption and iterate based on feedback and real-world usage.


Your Profile

• Strong software engineering foundation (Python, Java Script, or similar).
• Experience building end-to-end solutions (APIs, services, internal applications).• Good understanding of IT fundamentals and deployment practices(Open Shift experience is a plus).
• Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g. Denodo) and web application development.
• Ability to work effectively with incomplete requirements and multiple stakeholders.
• Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools (e.g., forecasting, optimization) without being a research-focused role.
• Experience integrating third-party APIs and automation tools.
• Familiarity with supply chain or operational workflows is a plus.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

description:
We are hiring for Software Engineer with strong hands on exposure in ML (Python, Java Script, or similar). Must have experience building end-to-end solutions (APIs, services, internal applications). Ability to work effectively with incomplete requirements and multiple stakeholders. Apply AI/ML-enabled tools where they add clear value.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

• Collaborate with software engineers and business analysts to clarify ambiguous problems, define requirements, and design practical solutions.
• Build and maintain internal platforms, APIs, and automation frameworks that enable multiple teams.
• Optimize existing workflows or create new, more efficient ones using bespoke tools, inter-departmental solutions, or existing company software.
• Apply AI/ML-enabled tools where they add clear value.
• Ensure solutions adhere to IT best practices without sacrificing timely delivery.
• Document assumptions, decisions, and limitations clearly.
• Monitor adoption and iterate based on feedback and real-world usage.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

• Strong software engineering foundation (Python, Java Script, or similar).
• Experience building end-to-end solutions (APIs, services, internal applications).• Good understanding of IT fundamentals and deployment practices(Open Shift experience is a plus).
• Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g. Denodo) and web application development.
• Ability to work effectively with incomplete requirements and multiple stakeholders.
• Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools (e.g., forecasting, optimization) without being a research-focused role.
• Experience integrating third-party APIs and automation tools.
• Familiarity with supply chain or operational workflows is a plus.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

Your Profile

• Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools (e.g., forecasting, optimization) without being a research-focused role.
• Experience integrating third-party APIs and automation tools.
• Familiarity with supply chain or operational workflows is a plus.

This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A \"disabled veteran\" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A \"recently separated veteran\" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An \"active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran\" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An \"Armed forces service medal veteran\" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended by the Jobs for Veterans Act of 2002, 38 U.S.C. 4212 (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment:
1. Disabled veterans
2. Recently separated veterans
3. Active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans
4. Armed Forces service medal veterans

These classifications are defined as follows:
• A "disabled veteran" is one of the following: A veteran of the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service who is entitled to compensation (or who but for the receipt of military retired pay would be entitled to compensation) under laws administered by the Secretary of Veterans Affairs or a person who was discharged or released from active duty because of a service-connected disability.
• A "recently separated veteran" means any veteran during the three-year period beginning on the date of such veteran's discharge or release from active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval, or air service.
• An "active duty wartime or campaign badge veteran" means a veteran who served on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service during a war, or in a campaign or expedition for which a campaign badge has been authorized under the laws administered by the Department of Defense.
• An "Armed forces service medal veteran" means a veteran who, while serving on active duty in the U.S. military, ground, naval or air service, participated in a United States military operation for which an Armed Forces service medal was awarded pursuant to Executive Order 12985.

Protected veterans may have additional rights under USERRA - the Uniformed Services Employment and Reemployment Rights Act. In particular, if you were absent from employment in order to perform service in the uniformed service, you may be entitled to be reemployed by your employer in the position you would have obtained with reasonable certainty if not for the absence due to service. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans Employment and Training Service (VETS), toll- free, at 1-866-4-USA-DOL.

title: HR Process Automation Specialist
jobDescription:
As a Process Automation specialist for HR, you will play a crucial role in streamlining and digitalizing repetitive HR processes in various HR domains. You will act as a strategic consultant to HR stakeholders and foster innovation and automation across Infineon’s HR organisation. The role involves identifying automation opportunities, designing and deploying automations, and ensuring seamless integration with HR systems to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. This role sits within the HR platforms and automation team at HR Digital and collaborates closely with IT HR and other teams globally.

HR Process Automation & Optimization

  • Analyze existing HR processes at different HR domains to identify automation opportunities.
  • Introducing automation and best practices to eliminate manual effort and reduce errors.
  • Lead end‑to‑end cross automation initiatives from requirement gathering through deployment and post‑implementation support.
Technology & Tools

  • Collabrating along with IT automation team for designing automation solutions by using tools such as RPA platforms, workflow automation tools, low‑code/no‑code platforms, and integrations with HR systems.
  • Ensure automation solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and follow Infineon’s HR automation principles.
Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Act as a trusted automation partner for HR teams, translating business needs into technical automation solutions.
  • Collaborate with IT and different HR stakeholders globally to ensure governance, data privacy, and audit readiness.
  • Support change management, user adoption, and training related to automated HR processes.
Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Monitor automation performance and KPIs (cycle time, error reduction, cost savings).
  • Identify opportunities for further optimisation and enhancement.
  • Document automation designs, processes, and controls for audit and knowledge sharing.


  • A university degree in Information Technology, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in a multinational environment, ideally in a similar HR Process Automation role
  • Strong background in requirement analysis & identifying automation potentials within HR
  • Solid experience with HR technologies and platforms, such as Human Resource Information System(HRIS), Applicant Tracking System(ATS), Learning Management System(LMS), and other digital tools supporting HR operations.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to realise an idea into a deployable product to significantly reduce HR manual efforts.
  • Hands-on experience or familiarity with automation tools is preferred.
  • A mindset focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and problem-solving.
  • Capability and passion to handle and drive several topics at the same time.
  • Fluent English skills are required.

title: Senior Staff Engineer Verification
jobDescription:
#We Are In to make sure that our circuits are designed to perfection.​ Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Verification of complex So Cs / IPs and provide technical leadership to the team while creating test plans and test bench architecture.
  • Development of constraint-random verification environment at both sub-system and So C level.
  • Develop expertise in multiple areas of verification – RTL, Gate level and Power aware simulations
  • Drive verification closure on complex modules and So Cs using SV/UVM based methodology.
  • Schedule management and handling cross functional team interactions
  • Should be a good mentor and guide for junior engineers in the team


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Electrical/Electronics Engineering Bachelor's - 9 to 11 years’ experience, Master’s - 8 to 10 years’ experience
  • In depth understanding of ASIC verification concepts and techniques. Ability to architect complex module / sub system / full chip testbenches and build verification infrastructure in SV/UVM.
  • Should be a good mentor and guide the junior engineers in the team.
  • Experience in ARM based So C verification covering RTL, Power Aware and Gate level simulations is a plus.
  • Good knowledge in industry standard protocols is preferable

title: Director Digital Design

experienceProfile.rawText:
Drive Digital mixed Signal Verification of Complex Signal processing IPs and chips Your Role Key responsibilities in your new role Drive Digital mixed Signal Verification of Complex Signal processing IPs and chips Enable AI in Verification Technical guidance and career mentorship to the team Lead from the front Hands-on experience building Simulink models that correlate to fixed-point hardware implementations (bit-accurate or tolerance-defined reference models). Experience collaborating with RTL design and DV teams (UVM/scoreboards/reference models), driving requirements-to-implementation traceability. Ability to interpret and integrate analog collateral (ADC behaviour, trims/calibration, validity timing, comparators/monitors) into digital models and verification plans. Strong system-thinking and ownership mindset; comfortable leading cross-team technical decisions and driving signoff-quality closure. Power converter control experience (multi-phase regulation, current sharing, transient optimization) is highly desired Mixed-signal verification exposure (co-simulation workflows, model correlation). Your Profile Qualifications and skills to help you succeed System modelling & specification: Build end-to-end behavioural models (plant + sensing + digital control + telemetry), define measurable requirements (stability, transient response, accuracy, latency), and translate them into implementable specs. Filter/algorithm implementation alignment: Own the modelling and fixed-point specification of key digital signal-processing elements (moving averages, programmable IIR poles/compensators, notch/CIC-style filters, envelope/marker capture, scaling/formatting), and work with RTL designers to ensure faithful implementation. Strong background in discrete-time filter design and fixed-point DSP implementation (IIR/PID, rounding/saturation behaviour, coefficient quantization, numeric stability). Cross-functional integration: Act as the technical interface between analog and digital teams; Define analog collateral (ADC behaviour, sampling/validity timing, trims/calibration, comparators/monitors) and ensure consistent assumptions in models, RTL, and verification. Verification strategy & closure: Define multi-level verification strategy (math-block golden models → subsystem digital verification →mixed-signal validation → full-chip end-to-end scenarios) and drive closure with verification leads. Bring-up & debug readiness: Define bring-up checklists, debug observability requirements, and lab validation plans; support root-cause analysis across RTL, firmware, and bench data. Documentation & leadership: Own technical collateral (architecture, modelling assumptions, coefficient derivations, fixed-point formats, test plans) and lead design/verification reviews.
